svg.title: Zones in Zonogy. A bar on each side edge of the display adds a tiling zone there. A new zone is empty: it shows a placeholder, with the Launcher open in it to pick a window for it. Clicking the placeholder's close button removes the zone. Dragging an app from the Dock onto a bar opens its window in a new zone on that side.
svg.text: Click a New Zone Bar to add a zone
Click × on an empty zone to remove it
Or drag an app from the Dock onto a bar: it opens in a new zone
